description.purpose: Deterministic ODCS v3.2.0 DataContract for spicy-regs publication family 'federal-register' (1 table(s)), targeting DDK domain 'spicygov'.
description.usage: Verify Parquet Arrow schema parity before publishing or consuming generations.

schema.name: federal_register
schema.description: One row per dated Federal Register record, keyed by (`document_number`, `publication_date`), ingested from the federalregister.gov REST API by `build_federal_register`. The authoritative rule-publication record — proposed rules, final rules, and notices — complementary to the regulations.gov `dockets`/`documents` view. `regulation_id_numbers` (RIN) and `cfr_references` are the join keys to the Unified Agenda and the CFR.

properties.name: document_number
properties.description: The Register's document number, spelled as it serves it (`2017-07442`, unpadded before 2013).

properties.name: title
properties.description: The document's title.

properties.name: abstract
properties.description: The agency's abstract of the document; often NULL.

properties.name: document_type
properties.description: The Register's category as the API states it: `Rule`, `Proposed Rule`, `Notice`, `Presidential Document`, and on older records `Uncategorized Document`, `Correction` (none after 2008-08-08) and `Sunshine Act Document`; NULL on a few records. Since 2008 a correction, an effective-date delay or a confirmation of a rule is itself typed `Rule` and shares the rule's RIN, docket and title; subtype is NULL on recent records, so tell them apart by `action`.

properties.name: publication_date
properties.description: The date the document was published, canonical YYYY-MM-DD.

properties.name: effective_on
properties.description: The `effective_on` date the Federal Register API states for the document. On a rule it is usually the effective date; the API also states one on some proposed rules and notices (a comment-period extension can carry the original proposal's date), so a date here does not by itself show that anything took effect. NULL where the API states none, as on most notices.

properties.name: comments_close_on
properties.description: The public comment deadline, for a document that opens a comment period; often NULL.

properties.name: signing_date
properties.description: The date a presidential document was signed; NULL for other documents.

properties.name: agencies

customProperties.value: STRUCT(id BIGINT, "name" VARCHAR, raw_name VARCHAR, parent_id BIGINT, slug VARCHAR)[]

properties.description: The issuing agencies as the Register's agency objects, a Native list preserved verbatim in publisher order. Each element corresponds to one publisher agency/subagency `<SUBAGY>`/`<AGENCY>` entry (`raw_name` distinct); canonical `name`, `id` and `slug` may legitimately repeat across elements and are intentionally not deduplicated. Stored as native nested values; list order, repeated values, null and empty collections remain distinct.

properties.name: agency_slugs
properties.description: The issuing agencies' Register slugs, comma-separated in publisher order (repeating a slug when multiple `agencies` entries resolve to the same canonical agency); NULL when none. Stored as native nested values; list order, repeated values, null and empty collections remain distinct.

properties.name: docket_ids
properties.description: The docket labels the document states, a Native list, as printed (many are agency numbers). Stored as native nested values; list order, repeated values, null and empty collections remain distinct.

properties.name: regulation_id_numbers
properties.description: The Regulation Identifier Numbers the API lists, a Native list. `[]` on a large share of Rule documents every year, an API limit: some of those state a RIN in the printed text, and some print it inside docket_ids. Stored as native nested values; list order, repeated values, null and empty collections remain distinct.

properties.name: cfr_references

customProperties.value: STRUCT(title BIGINT, part VARCHAR, chapter VARCHAR)[]

properties.description: The CFR citations the document affects, a Native list of `{title, part, chapter, citation_url}`. Stored as native nested values; list order, repeated values, null and empty collections remain distinct.

properties.name: topics

customProperties.value: RefSpec Atlas Federal Register API topics scheme

properties.description: The Register's CFR index terms for the document (`topics`), a Native list; `[]` when it lists none. Stored as native nested values; list order, repeated values, null and empty collections remain distinct.

properties.name: volume
properties.description: The Federal Register volume.

properties.name: start_page
properties.description: The document's first page.

properties.name: end_page
properties.description: The document's last page.

properties.name: subtype
properties.description: The Register's subtype when the API sets it; NULL on recent records, so it does not separate a correction from its rule (`action` does).

properties.name: executive_order_number
properties.description: The executive order number, for a presidential executive order; NULL otherwise.

properties.name: modify_date
properties.description: Always NULL: the Register's API states no update instant.

properties.name: rin
properties.description: The host's derived first RIN of `regulation_id_numbers`; NULL when it states none.

properties.name: regulations_dot_gov_docket_id
properties.description: The regulations.gov docket the Register states for this document; NULL where it states none, even where it states a document: a docket is never read off the front of a document id.

properties.name: regulations_dot_gov_document_id
properties.description: The regulations.gov document the Register states for this document; NULL where it states none.

properties.name: regulations_dot_gov_comments_count
properties.description: Regulations.gov's comment count for that document as the Register relayed it at regulations_dot_gov_checked_at. The Register stops checking soon after the comment period closes, so the count is as of that check. It can be far higher than the comments regulations.gov posts (IRS-2024-0010-0001: 384,423 against 12 posted, 2026-10-03): a different fact from the posted comment rows this service holds. NULL where the Register states no count.

properties.name: regulations_dot_gov_checked_at
properties.description: When the Register last checked regulations.gov for this document, as it states it (UTC); NULL where it has not checked.

properties.name: action
properties.description: The document's action line as the API states it (`Final rule.`, `Final rule; correction.`, `Proposed rule; extension of comment period.`); NULL where it states none, as on many older records. It tells a rule from its later correction, delay or confirmation, which share the rule's type, RIN, docket and title.

properties.name: correction_of
properties.description: For one of the Register's own editorial corrections (numbered like `C1-2012-1234`), the API address of the document it corrects; NULL otherwise. An agency's correction published as a rule carries no such link; its `action` names it a correction.

properties.name: corrections
properties.description: The API addresses of the corrections the Register links to this document (its own editorial corrections), a Native list; `[]` where it links none. NULL on a row not read since the field was first requested (2026-10-03). Stored as native nested values; list order, repeated values, null and empty collections remain distinct.

properties.name: significant
properties.description: Whether the document was deemed significant under Executive Order 12866, as the API states it: `true` or `false`; NULL where the API states neither, which is common, so NULL does not mean `false`.

properties.name: president_json
properties.description: The Register's literal presidential attribution object, with identifier and name; no signer inference. NULL means unrequested/missing; JSON null and an empty object remain distinct.

properties.name: disposition_notes
properties.description: Literal Register disposition prose; NULL if missing/null, empty text if stated empty.

properties.name: executive_order_notes
properties.description: Literal Register executive-order history prose, including spelling and line breaks; not an independently established current legal effect.

properties.name: regulations_dot_gov_agency_id
properties.description: Agency identifier stated by the linked Regulations.gov document metadata.

properties.name: regulations_dot_gov_title
properties.description: Title stated by the linked Regulations.gov document metadata.

properties.name: regulations_dot_gov_regulation_id_number
properties.description: Regulation identifier number stated by the linked Regulations.gov metadata; no inferred docket or rule match.

properties.name: regulations_dot_gov_supporting_documents_count
properties.description: Supporting-document count stated by Regulations.gov for the linked document.

properties.name: regulations_dot_gov_supporting_documents
properties.description: Supporting document identifiers and titles listed by Regulations.gov, preserving source order and repetition. Stored as native nested values; list order, repeated values, null and empty collections remain distinct.

properties.name: regulations_dot_gov_regulatory_plan_title
properties.description: Regulatory-plan title stated in the linked Regulations.gov metadata.

properties.name: html_url
properties.description: The document's page on federalregister.gov.

properties.name: pdf_url
properties.description: The document's PDF rendition.

properties.name: body_html_url
properties.description: The document's full-text HTML body; the XML body the Register also serves carries no boilerplate.

properties.name: source_sha256
properties.description: SHA-256 of the retained Federal Register API page this row was last read from, as the run's source-evidence journal spells it (`sha256:<hex>`); the page is `source-evidence/blobs/sha256/<hex>`. NULL on a row no run has read since the column was added (2026-11). It is a pointer, not part of the record: the scheduled run re-reads the last 120 days, so it changes every night on every row in that window (about 8,700) whether or not the record changed, and a comparison of two generations must leave it out. Where one run reads a document on two pages it names the first.

properties.name: regulations_dot_gov_info_json
properties.description: The Register's own statement of the regulations.gov docket and document it matched this document to (the API's `regulations_dot_gov_info`), a JSON object exactly as stated: `{}` where the Register states nothing, the time of its check alone where it checked and found nothing, otherwise any of the docket, the document, the comment count, the supporting documents and their titles. NULL on a row not read since the field was first requested (2026-10-03).

schema.dataGranularityDescription: One row per dated Federal Register document: a rule, proposed rule, notice or presidential document.

customProperties.value: unified_agenda holds every readable edition, Fall 1995 to the newest. Of the 6,090 RINs no edition lists, 2,211 are NMFS's 0648-X in-season series (every one), 1,409 first appear before Fall 1995, 179 first appear in 2026, after the newest edition, and 460 are malformed as printed (3206-XXXX, 7100 AG80). Receipt join-map-2026-09-26/unified-agenda-rin-after-backfill.json.
